09267660-c676-46bf-8c7f-e363fe1a148e.title: Chaqaloqning tepishlari 👶
09267660-c676-46bf-8c7f-e363fe1a148e.body: Bugun chaqalog‘ingizning harakatlarini qayd etishni unutmang!

143a6067-ccae-4656-ba58-73fbcda5af25.title: Salomatlik kundaligi 📝
143a6067-ccae-4656-ba58-73fbcda5af25.body: Bugungi kayfiyatingiz va alomatlaringizni qayd eting.

86369e0e-4f13-4d59-b837-3f52513dd6ce.title: Kun eslatmasi 💧
86369e0e-4f13-4d59-b837-3f52513dd6ce.body: Suv ichishni unutmang! Salomatligingiz uchun kuniga 8 stakan suv iching.

a808f6e4-abd8-43fb-9582-9221f7780b20.title: Harakatlanish vaqti 🚶‍♀️
a808f6e4-abd8-43fb-9582-9221f7780b20.body: Biroz sayr qilish salomatligingiz uchun foydali.

ab7587a3-43b8-4685-a87c-500223c50943.title: Hayz eslatmasi 🌸
ab7587a3-43b8-4685-a87c-500223c50943.body: Keyingi hayz sanangiz yaqinlashmoqda. Tayyor turing!

b23e355a-80c4-49c5-acab-e255287eb9d0.title: Kuningiz Xayrli O‘tsin ☀️
b23e355a-80c4-49c5-acab-e255287eb9d0.body: Kuningiz xayrli bo‘lsin! Bugun o‘zingizga vaqt ajrating.

e2a2b1d9-59e6-42ab-a7e9-71b13a431c12.title: Juftingizning Ko‘magi 💑
e2a2b1d9-59e6-42ab-a7e9-71b13a431c12.body: Bugun ham turmush o‘rtog‘ingizni qo‘llab-quvvatlashni unutmang!

f099172d-897e-44f4-ad64-884bd19163f0.title: Ona Bo‘lish Go‘zal 🤱
f099172d-897e-44f4-ad64-884bd19163f0.body: Chaqalog‘ingiz bilan o‘tgan har bir lahza qadrli. Bu lahzalarni qadrlang!

fc9a8c00-299a-44bb-96ef-47bee0a5ce3a.title: O‘zingizga G‘amxo‘rlik ❤️
fc9a8c00-299a-44bb-96ef-47bee0a5ce3a.body: Homiladorlik davrida dam olish juda muhim. Biroz dam oling.
